[[File:Éclairisse.png|thumb|250px|Éclairisse]] '''Éclairisse''' (Japanese: '''エクレール''' ''Éclair'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[XY048|A Campus Reunion!]]''. She is a researcher at a [[Kalos]] {{pkmn|academy}} specializing in {{type|Electric}} Pokémon and was {{an|Clemont}}'s teacher in his youth when he studied at the said academy. Éclairisse was surprised to see Clemont again and invited him and {{ashfr}} to tour the local academy. After that, Éclairisse told the group more about Clemont's time at the academy, remarking that he was a brilliant student. The town's electrical supply came under attack from {{TRT}}, so Éclairisse and the group rushed to investigate the blackouts. She stood on standby while {{Ash}} and Clemont battled the Rocket trio.
